products.title: Meals To Go - Summit Savory Chicken
products.body_html:
Ingredients: Free-Range Chicken, Organic Spinach, Broccoli, Sweet Potato, Onion, Organic Carrot, Mushroom, Organic Lemon, Green Onion, Organic Parsley, Organic Cilantro, Turmeric, Organic Garlic, Sea Salt.

Net dry weight 3oz/85g.

36-month shelf-life.

Summit Savory Chicken is a subtle balance of free-range chicken, broccoli, and sweet potato to keep you full and happy wherever life takes you!

products.title: Meals To Go - Bedrock Beef Chili
products.body_html:
Ingredients: 100% Grass-Fed Beef, Sweet Potato, Organic Carrots, Onion, Organic Tomato, Green Bell Pepper, Red Bell Pepper, Sea Salt, Green Onion, Cayenne Pepper, Cumin, Organic Garlic, Black Pepper, Coriander Seed.

Bedrock Beef Chili is the classic chili taste you know and love. Made with 100% grass-fed beef, sweet potato, and a blend of mild peppers, you can enjoy this hearty meal anywhere life takes you!

Net weight 3oz/85g and 12-month shelf-life.

products.title: Quinoa Meals – Herb Roasted Chicken with Spinach, Carrots & Herbs
products.body_html:
Ingredients: Organic Quinoa, Free-Range Chicken, Organic Carrots, Organic Garlic, Organic Onion, Organic Spinach, Sea Salt, Celery, Turmeric, Organic Rosemary, Organic Parsley

Oil Ingredients: 100% Cold Pressed Extra Virgin Olive Oil

A simple, homey comfort meal, Herb Roasted Chicken Quick Quinoa Meal draws inspiration from all the best parts of Chicken Noodle Soup. *Nightshade-Free and AIP-diet friendly!

3oz/86g dry weight, plus 10g olive oil packet.
